- Subprocessor CSV & SOC2: we will deliver a CSV with region/country and a SOC2 Type II summary (auditor: Brightline Audit LLP; period: 2025-07 to 2026-06). Full SOC2 report can be shared under the mutual NDA.

Draft mapping snippet (feel free to paste):
"The Data Processing Addendum (DPA) forms part of and supplements the Order Form. The DPA sets out the respective obligations of the parties in relation to the Processing of Personal Data as contemplated under Sections 3 (Security), 6 (Subprocessors) and 9 (International Data Transfers) of the Order Form. In the event of any inconsistency between the Order Form and the DPA, the DPA provisions relating to data protection shall prevail solely to the extent necessary to give effect to applicable Data Protection Laws."

I'll attach a marked DPA with the subprocessor annex + the short transfer-addendum draft by EOD. Monica — can you confirm we have the export_controls_matrix completed for MedCore's region?
